R_CFIMI.rule: Do not rely on R/CFIMI as the sole live intake. Ask current State components to route to any remaining or successor foreign-information-manipulation function.

recommended_internal_route: CDP/ICP for international communications and information policy
CDP/CDF for digital freedom, information integrity, and repressive state-controlled cyberspace practices
CDP/ICS for international cyberspace security and partner capacity
ET/TA and ET/C for cross-domain emerging-threat/cyber assessment
INR/CET for foreign-government cyber, telecom, and emerging-technology analysis
any current State component retaining foreign information manipulation/interference responsibilities
public_electronic_route_rule: Use only publicly published State/CDP email addresses; request internal routing; do not invent a CFIMI address.
